name: data-list
title: Data List
description: A generic, typed data table — configurable columns, row selection, sortable headers, plus loading and empty states.

meta.whenToUse: A list of records as a table with typed columns, selection, click-to-sort, and loading/empty states.
meta.whenNotToUse: A board/kanban view (Board), full-parity grids with grouping/editing/virtualization (DataGrid), or a simple static table (Table).
